verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers a business bank account and a Money Dashboard showing cash balance and inflows and outflows, so a cash-management axis applies. However, no evidence documents automatic top-ups between accounts or low-balance alerts. The cash-forecasting CLI skill and bank-account webhook events are adjacent building blocks, not the requested automation.
